function.name: geo_location_based_products_fetch_eco_friendly_products
function.description: Locate eco-friendly products near a specific geographic location based on product category and shopping preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Your city or the geographical location you're interested in shopping from. e.g., Seattle, WA

product_category.description: The category of product that you're interested in. e.g., Yoga Mats, Bamboo toothbrush, etc

availability.description: Your preferred method of getting the product - Instore, Online, or Both.

message.content: 好的！請問您想在哪個城市或地區尋找這種店內可購買的 GMO 瑜伽墊？這樣我才能幫您搜尋附近的商店。
message.reasoning: The user wants to find an in-store GMO yoga mat. They want to locate eco-friendly products near a specific geographic location based on product category and shopping preferences. We need to call the function geo_location_based_products_fetch_eco_friendly_products with location, product_category, availability. But we don't have a location from the user. The user didn't specify a city. We need to ask for location. The user said "尋找一個可以在店內購買的GMO瑜伽墊。" That is Chinese: "Looking for a GMO yoga mat that can be purchased in-store." We need to ask for location. So respond asking for location.
